test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Zinc oxide is a form of rust.
Copper can also turn into rust upon hydration.
Chemically rust is hydrated ferric oxide.
Chemically rust is non-hydrated ferric oxide.

solution:
The Correct Answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chemically rust is hydrated ferric oxide.**
 
• Rust specifically refers to the result of the corrosion of iron, forming a compound primarily consisting of hydrated iron(III) oxide **(Fe₂O₃·nH₂O).**
 
• Zinc oxide and copper do not form rust; they undergo different types of corrosion and patination, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zinc **corrodes when exposed to air and moisture.

 
 
• However, this element does not rust like most other metals. Iron, for example, reacts with water and oxygen in the atmosphere to form hydrated iron oxide on the metal's surface.
 
 
 
• **Copper** does not react with water, but it does slowly react with atmospheric oxygen to form a layer of brown-black copper oxide which, unlike the rust that forms on iron in moist air, protects the underlying metal from further corrosion.
 
• **Iron** reacts with oxygen, when exposed to moisture, it forms a chemical substance that is brown in colour and is referred to as rust.
